schemes.title: JharSewa — Jharkhand e-District Certificates
schemes.department: Department of Information Technology & e-Governance, Government of Jharkhand
schemes.brief: JharSewa is Jharkhand's e-District system. Caste, income and residence (domicile) certificates, birth and death certificates, land record services and social security pension applications are filed here instead of at the block office, and the signed certificate is downloaded from the same login. A Pragya Kendra (Common Service Centre) will file it for you for the notified fee if you cannot do it yourself.
schemes.benefit: Caste, income, residence, birth and death certificates applied for and downloaded online
eligibility: Resident of Jharkhand, applying in the block and circle where the family actually lives
A residence (domicile) certificate needs proof that the family lives in Jharkhand — the ration card and the land or rent record for that address
A caste certificate is issued only for a caste on Jharkhand's own list, and is checked against the father's certificate
An income certificate states the household income for one financial year, so departments ask for a recent one
The mobile number linked to your Aadhaar must be working, because the whole process runs on OTP and SMS
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Ration card of the family
Address proof — electricity bill, holding tax receipt or rent agreement
Father's caste certificate, for a caste certificate
Income proof — salary certificate, or a self-declaration where there is no salary
School leaving certificate or Class 10 marksheet for date of birth
Land record (khatiyan or rent receipt), where the claim rests on land in the family's name
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: Caste, income, residence, birth, death, land record or pension. Each service has its own form and its own list of proofs.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate prints exactly from this box.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: The family is traced through this name in the revenue and caste records, so use the spelling on his own papers.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on the Class 10 certificate or the birth certificate, not as remembered.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Identity is confirmed on this and the OTP goes to the mobile linked to it.

demoFields.label: District / Block / Panchayat / Village
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The Circle Officer of this circle signs the certificate.

demoFields.label: Caste and Category
demoFields.hint: Write the caste exactly as it appears on your father's caste certificate. The office checks it against the state's notified list.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: The whole household's income for the year — wages, farming, shop, rent and pension together, not only your own.

demoFields.label: Purpose
demoFields.hint: Recorded on the file. It does not limit where you can use the certificate afterwards.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the 'certificate ready' message come here by SMS.

demoSteps: Register on jharsewa.jharkhand.gov.in with your name, mobile and email and confirm the OTP — or take the papers to a Pragya Kendra or your block office, which files it across the counter for the notified fee.
Pick the service and fill the form from your Aadhaar and ration card. Do not mix up the block and the panchayat; the file is routed on them.
Upload the scans, submit, and write down the application number. Everything after this is tracked on that number alone.
The Circle Officer's staff verify the claim. For a caste certificate the check runs through your father's record, so keep his certificate at hand.
When it is approved, download the digitally signed certificate from the same login. A digitally signed copy does not need any further attestation.
Jharkhand's service guarantee law fixes a time limit for each of these certificates. If it passes, quote the application number to the Circle Officer, then at the Deputy Commissioner's office.
schemes.helpline: No helpline number is published for JharSewa. Ask at your block office (prakhand karyalaya) or the nearest Pragya Kendra, and at the District Informatics Office for a technical problem with the portal.

schemes.title: e-Kalyan Jharkhand — Scholarships for SC, ST, OBC and Minority Students
schemes.department: Department of Scheduled Tribe, Scheduled Caste, Minority and Backward Class Welfare, Government of Jharkhand
schemes.brief: e-Kalyan is the Jharkhand welfare department's own scholarship portal — it is separate from the National Scholarship Portal. SC, ST, OBC and minority students apply here for pre-matric scholarships (Classes 1 to 10) and post-matric scholarships (college and above), renew them each year and check the payment. The portal reports 6 schemes and Rs 1,339.35 crore disbursed in 2024-25. The address is ekalyan.cgg.gov.in and not a jharkhand.gov.in name because the system is hosted by the Centre for Good Governance.
schemes.benefit: Pre-matric and post-matric scholarship paid by DBT into the student's own bank account
eligibility: Student belongs to a Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Backward Class or notified minority community of Jharkhand
Student is domiciled in Jharkhand — the scholarship follows the home state, not the state where the college is
Studying in a recognised school or institution that is registered on the portal; if your college is not registered, it cannot verify your form
Family income must be within the limit notified for that scholarship for the year, so read the notice on the portal before filling the form
The bank account must be in the student's own name and seeded with the student's Aadhaar; a parent's or joint account is rejected
Renewal is applied for every year and is not automatic
documents: Aadhaar card of the student
Caste certificate issued in Jharkhand, or the minority declaration
Income certificate of the parent or guardian
Residence (domicile) certificate of Jharkhand
Last passed marksheet
Fee receipt or admission receipt from the institution for the current year
Bank passbook in the student's own name showing account number and IFSC
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Scholarship applied for
demoFields.hint: Pre-matric is for Classes 1 to 10, post-matric for college and above. Choose fresh for the first year and renewal after that.

demoFields.label: Student Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar and on the marksheet. A mismatch stops the payment at the bank stage.

demoFields.label: Father's / Guardian's Name
demoFields.hint: The same name as on the income certificate you are uploading.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As printed on the Class 10 certificate.

demoFields.label: Category
demoFields.hint: Exactly as on the caste certificate. The scheme and the rate depend on this.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. The same Aadhaar must be seeded to the bank account, or the DBT transfer fails.

demoFields.label: District / Block
demoFields.hint: Your home district and block. The district welfare officer of this district sanctions the scholarship.

demoFields.label: Institution, Course and Year
demoFields.value: P.K. Roy Memorial College, Dhanbad — B.A. (Hons) History — 2nd year
demoFields.hint: Pick the institution from the portal's list. If it is not listed, ask the college to get itself registered first.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: Copy the figure from the income certificate you are uploading. The two must be the same number.

demoFields.label: Bank Account Number and IFSC
demoFields.hint: The student's own account. Copy both from the first page of the passbook, digit by digit.

demoSteps: Watch ekalyan.cgg.gov.in for the year's notice. Pre-matric and post-matric open on different dates and the last date is hard — a late form is not accepted.
Before anything else, open a bank account in the student's own name and get the student's Aadhaar seeded to it at the branch. Payment is by DBT and a parent's or joint account is rejected.
Register as a student with your mobile and Aadhaar, then fill the form: category, institution, course, year, fees paid and bank details.
Upload the caste certificate, income certificate, residence certificate, last marksheet and the fee receipt. Submit and note the application number.
Your institution must verify the application on its own login. Go to the college office and confirm that it has been forwarded — more applications stall at this step than anywhere else.
The district welfare office sanctions it and the money is credited to the seeded account. Check the payment status on the portal with the same login.
Apply again for renewal in the next academic year. A renewal that misses the last date lapses and cannot be claimed later.
schemes.helpline: No helpline number is published on the portal. Contact the District Welfare Officer of your district, or the welfare section of your college, which holds the institution login.

schemes.title: Akshaya e-Kendras — Kerala's Assisted Service Centres
schemes.department: Akshaya Project, Kerala State IT Mission
schemes.brief: Akshaya is Kerala's own network of assisted service centres — about 2,650 e-Kendras, with at least two in every panchayat. You walk in and an operator files the application for you: e-District certificates such as income, community, nativity and possession, e-Grantz scholarship forms, Aadhaar enrolment, update and seeding, birth and death certificate printing, and utility and fee payments. The network started on 18 November 2002 and has handled over 1.81 crore Aadhaar enrolments. The website lists the services and the centres; the filing itself happens at the counter.
schemes.benefit: Assisted filing of certificates, scholarships, Aadhaar work and payments at about 2,650 centres
eligibility: Anyone living in Kerala can use an Akshaya e-Kendra; you do not need an account on the website
You must still meet the conditions of the department whose service you are applying for — Akshaya only files it
Aadhaar is needed for most services, and for e-District certificates the mobile linked to it has to be working for the OTP
Service charges are fixed by the government for each service and are displayed at the centre; the department's own fee is separate
For Aadhaar enrolment or update of a child, a parent must come along with their own Aadhaar
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant — original and one photocopy
Ration card of the family
Address proof — electricity bill, water bill or land tax receipt
Income proof — salary certificate, or a self-declaration where there is no salary, for an income certificate
Community or caste certificate of a parent, for a community certificate
School certificate or birth certificate for date of birth
Bank passbook, for scholarship and other DBT services
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: District (centre search)
demoFields.hint: Pick your district on the site to list the Akshaya centres near you before you set out.

demoFields.label: Local body / Panchayat
demoFields.hint: Narrows the list to the centres in your own panchayat or municipality. There are at least two in every panchayat.

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: Check the service list on the site first — it also shows what the service costs and what to carry.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate prints from this entry in both Malayalam and English.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: As on his own Aadhaar or ration card, since the family is identified through it.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. The operator verifies you on this and the OTP comes to the linked mobile.

demoFields.label: Address — House, Village, Taluk, District
demoFields.value: Thekkethil House, Koratty, Chalakudy Taluk, Thrissur
demoFields.hint: The address the village officer will verify. Use the one on the ration card.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: The whole household's income for the year from every source. The village officer checks this before the certificate is signed.

demoFields.label: Purpose
demoFields.value: Fee concession for daughter's degree admission
demoFields.hint: Recorded on the file. It does not restrict where the certificate can be used.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the 'ready' message come here by SMS, so give a number you carry.

demoSteps: Find your nearest e-Kendra on akshaya.kerala.gov.in and read the service page, which lists what to carry and what the service costs.
Carry the originals and one photocopy of each document. The operator scans the originals at the counter.

The operator fills the form for you. Before it is submitted, read the name, age, address and income back off the screen — in Malayalam and in English. A spelling mistake here means applying all over again.
Pay the government fee and the notified service charge and take the printed receipt. The application number on it is the only way to follow the file.
The village officer verifies income, residence and family claims. You may be called to the village office, so stay reachable.
An SMS tells you when it is ready. Collect the signed certificate at the centre or download it yourself; a digitally signed copy needs no attestation.
The service charges are fixed and displayed at the centre. If more than that is asked, complain to the District Akshaya Project Office for your district.
schemes.helpline: No statewide helpline number is published. Contact the District Akshaya Project Office (District Project Manager) for your district, or the e-Kendra itself for a query about your own application.

schemes.title: Thulasi — Kerala PSC Registration and Applications
schemes.brief: Thulasi is the Kerala Public Service Commission's application system. You build one profile — the One Time Registration — and then apply from it to every PSC notification: Last Grade Servants, Lower Division Clerk, Civil Police Officer, Village Extension Officer, Staff Nurse, Assistant Professor, departmental tests and hundreds of other posts. There is no application fee. The same login is used to update the profile, confirm each application, download the admission ticket and see the short list and the rank list.
schemes.benefit: One profile, then applications to every Kerala PSC notification at no fee
eligibility: Indian citizen; most Kerala PSC posts also require Kerala nativity, and each notification states its own condition
Age limits are set in each notification, commonly 18 to 36 years on 1 January of the qualifying year, with the relaxations allowed to SC, ST and OBC candidates
One person may hold only one Thulasi profile — a second profile blocks you from applying
The qualification named in the notification must already be entered in your profile, and acquired before the last date, or you cannot apply for that post
The photograph must have been taken within six months of creating the profile, with your name and the date printed on it, for profiles created from 1 January 2022
documents: Photograph taken within the last six months, with your name and the date of the photograph printed below the face
Scanned signature
SSLC book or Class 10 certificate, for the name and the date of birth
Degree, diploma or other qualification certificates named in the notification
Community certificate, for an SC, ST or OBC claim
Non-creamy layer certificate, for an OBC claim
Aadhaar card
Nativity certificate, where the notification asks for one

demoFields.label: Name (as in SSLC Book)
demoFields.hint: Exactly as in the SSLC book, including initials. The rank list and the advice memo will carry this name.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth (as in SSLC Book)
demoFields.hint: From the SSLC book only. Age for every post is counted from this date and it cannot be changed afterwards.

demoFields.label: Gender
demoFields.hint: Some posts are notified for women only, and the system filters on this.

demoFields.label: Religion, Caste and Community
demoFields.hint: As on your community certificate. Age relaxation and reservation are given on this entry, so an error here costs you the claim.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. It ties the profile to you and stops a duplicate registration.

demoFields.label: Permanent Address — House, Post Office, District, PIN
demoFields.hint: The address for post from the Commission. Keep it current in the profile if you move.

demoFields.label: Educational Qualification
demoFields.value: B.Com, University of Kerala, passed May 2022
demoFields.hint: Add every qualification with the month and year it was acquired. You can only apply for a post whose qualification is already in the profile.

demoFields.label: Photograph
demoFields.value: Photo taken 12-02-2026, with 'Anoop Krishnan' and the date printed below the face
demoFields.hint: Taken within the last six months, name and date printed on it. A photo without this is rejected.

demoFields.label: Access Code
demoFields.hint: A short word you choose. You are asked for it every time you confirm an application, so write it down somewhere safe.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: Notification alerts, the admission ticket message and the rank list message come here.

demoSteps: Get the photograph right before you start: taken within the last six months, with your name and the date printed below the face. A profile created from 1 January 2022 is rejected without it.
Open thulasi.psc.kerala.gov.in, click New Registration and fill the profile from your SSLC book. Name, date of birth and community must match it exactly.
Save the user ID, the password and the access code. The access code is asked again each time you confirm an application.
Enter every qualification in the profile with the date you acquired it. A post will not open for you unless its qualification is already recorded.
Open the notification you want and click Apply. Kerala PSC charges no application fee.
Confirm the application before the last date. An application that is submitted but never confirmed is not considered at all — this is the commonest way candidates lose a chance.
Download the admission ticket when it is released, then follow the short list, the rank list and the advice memo through the same login.
schemes.helpline: No helpline number is published for Thulasi. Contact the Kerala PSC District Office of your district, or the Commission's office at Pattom, Thiruvananthapuram. Akshaya e-Kendras also help with the registration.

schemes.title: e-Sewa Punjab — Sewa Kendra Certificates and Services
schemes.department: Department of Governance Reforms and Public Grievances, Government of Punjab
schemes.brief: e-Sewa Punjab is the Sewa Kendra counter put online. More than 400 services of over 30 departments run through it — birth, death and marriage certificates, caste, residence and income certificates, fard (a copy of the land record), arms licence, vehicle and driving licence services, labour registration and social security pensions. You can file it yourself with a mobile OTP, or hand the papers in at any Sewa Kendra and let the counter do it.
schemes.benefit: Over 400 services of more than 30 departments, filed online or at a Sewa Kendra
eligibility: Resident of Punjab, applying in the tehsil where the family actually lives
A residence certificate needs proof that the family has been living in Punjab — the ration card, an old electricity bill or a school record for the address
A caste certificate is issued only for a caste on Punjab's notified list and is checked against the father's certificate
An income certificate covers one financial year, and departments normally want a recently issued one
You need a mobile number that can take the OTP, and it should be the one linked to your Aadhaar
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Ration card or blue card of the family
Address proof — electricity bill, water bill or house tax receipt
Father's caste certificate, for a caste certificate
Income proof — salary slip, or a self-declaration and affidavit where there is no salary
Matriculation certificate or birth certificate for date of birth
Copy of the jamabandi or rent agreement, where the address rests on land or a tenancy
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Department and Service
demoFields.hint: Pick the department first, then the service. Each one has its own form, its own fee and its own delivery time.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate prints from this box in Punjabi and English.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: As on his own Aadhaar or the family's ration card, since the family is traced through it.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on the matriculation certificate or the birth certificate.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Identity is confirmed on this and the OTP goes to the linked mobile.

demoFields.label: District / Tehsil / Village or Ward
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The tehsil office named here processes and signs the certificate.

demoFields.label: Caste and Category
demoFields.hint: Exactly as on your father's caste certificate. Leave it blank if the service does not need it.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: The household's total for the year — wages, farming, shop and rent together, not just the applicant's earnings.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number, the OTP and the 'ready for collection' message all come here.

demoSteps: Register on esewa.punjab.gov.in with your mobile number and the OTP — or take the papers to any Sewa Kendra and let the counter file it for you.
Choose the department and the service, then fill the form. The name must match the Aadhaar letter for letter, or the file comes back for correction.
Upload the scans, pay the fee, and keep the receipt. It carries the application number and the date the service is promised by.
The patwari or the tehsil clerk verifies the address, the income or the caste claim. Stay reachable on the mobile you gave.

Track the application number on the portal. When it is approved, download the digitally signed certificate from the same login or collect it at the Sewa Kendra — a digitally signed copy needs no attestation.
If the promised date passes, Punjab's service delivery law gives you an appeal to the department's designated appellate officer. Quote the application number when you file it.
schemes.helpline: No helpline number is published for e-Sewa. Ask at the Sewa Kendra counter in your tehsil, or at the District Governance Reforms office in the Deputy Commissioner's complex.

schemes.title: Jamabandi Punjab — Land Records, Fard and Mutation
schemes.department: Punjab Land Records Society, Department of Revenue, Rehabilitation and Disaster Management, Government of Punjab
schemes.brief: Punjab's land records portal. Looking up the jamabandi by owner name, khewat, khatauni or khasra number is free and needs no account, and you can also see mutations, the roznamcha and registered deeds. A digital fard can be bought and delivered on WhatsApp. Requests for virasat (inheritance) mutation, mutation on a registered deed (vasika), fard badar correction, rapat entry and oral or family partition under the Chief Minister's 30-day taksim scheme are filed on the same site with a mobile OTP, and tracked on the application number.
schemes.benefit: Free jamabandi viewing, digital fard on WhatsApp, and mutation requests filed online
eligibility: The land must lie in Punjab and be entered in the jamabandi of that village
Viewing the jamabandi, mutations, roznamcha and registered deeds is free and open to anyone, with no login
For a virasat mutation you must be a legal heir of the owner recorded in the jamabandi
For a mutation on a deed, the vasika must already be registered at the sub-registrar's office before you file here
For the Chief Minister's 30-day partition scheme, every co-sharer of the khewat has to agree to the partition
You need a mobile number that can take the OTP; there is no standing citizen account, so the application number is your only handle on the file
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Copy of the current jamabandi (fard) showing the khewat, khatauni and khasra numbers
Death certificate of the recorded owner, for a virasat mutation
Family tree (kursinama) of the heirs, attested by the sarpanch or the patwari
Registered deed (vasika) with its registration number and date, for a deed mutation
Written consent of all co-sharers, for a family partition
Court order or decree, where the land is under one
Mobile number for the OTP, and for WhatsApp delivery of a digital fard

demoFields.label: Request type
demoFields.hint: Virasat mutation, mutation on a registered vasika, fard badar, rapat, or partition. Each has its own page on the site.

demoFields.label: District
demoFields.hint: The district where the land is, which is not always the district you live in.

demoFields.label: Tehsil
demoFields.hint: The revenue tehsil of the land. The Revenue Officer of this tehsil sanctions the mutation.

demoFields.label: Village / Hadbast
demoFields.hint: Pick the village from the dropdown. The dropdown takes a moment to load, so wait for the list.

demoFields.label: Jamabandi Year
demoFields.hint: Jamabandi is rewritten every five years. Choose the latest year shown for your village.

demoFields.label: Khewat / Khatauni Number
demoFields.hint: Copy both from the fard exactly. The whole request is filed against these numbers.

demoFields.label: Khasra (Killa) Numbers
demoFields.hint: Every khasra of the holding being mutated, with the slashes as printed in the record.

demoFields.label: Name of the recorded owner
demoFields.value: Bachan Singh son of Inder Singh
demoFields.hint: The name as it stands in the jamabandi, not as spoken. For a virasat mutation this is the deceased owner.

demoFields.label: Applicant's name and relation
demoFields.value: Manjit Singh — son of the deceased
demoFields.hint: Your name as on Aadhaar and how you are related to the recorded owner. List every heir; leaving one out means the mutation has to be redone.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number for OTP
demoFields.hint: The OTP, the application number and the hearing date come here. A digital fard is delivered to this number on WhatsApp.

demoSteps: Open jamabandi.punjab.gov.in and view the jamabandi free first — search by owner name, khewat, khatauni or khasra. Write down the spelling and the numbers exactly as the record shows them.
If you only need a copy, use the digital fard service; it can be sent to your mobile on WhatsApp for the notified fee. A paid subscription is offered for people who need fards often.
For inheritance, open the Virasat mutation request, fill the district, tehsil, village, jamabandi year and khewat, add every legal heir, and verify your mobile number by OTP. No account is needed.
Note the application number the site gives you and follow it on the online request status page.
The patwari enters the rapat in the roznamcha and the Revenue Officer — Naib Tehsildar or Tehsildar — sanctions the mutation after hearing the co-sharers. Attend the hearing when you are called.
Once it is sanctioned, look up the jamabandi again and check the new names, the shares and the khasra numbers. If anything is wrong, file a Fard Badar correction request on the same site.
There is a grievance form on the portal with its own tracking number. Use it if the request sits without movement, and keep the application number with you.
schemes.helpline: No helpline number is published on the portal. Contact the Fard Kendra or the Tehsildar's office of the tehsil where the land lies, and the Punjab Land Records Society through the Deputy Commissioner's office if it is not resolved there.
